headline: Revolut in Talks With Philippine Central Bank for Digital Banking License
summary: British financial technology company Revolut is engaged in discussions with the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas to secure a digital banking license and enter the Philippine market.
why: Revolut is one of Europe's most valuable private fintech companies. Securing banking charters in high-growth Southeast Asian economies accelerates international diversification for digital neobanks.

impacts.name: Fintech
impacts.why: Licensing a major global digital bank increases retail financial inclusion and boosts digital payments infrastructure.
